last.verdict: PENN's casinos set a third-quarter revenue record and its online losses shrank sharply, pushing profit up and debt down.

takeaways.label: Online losses shrinking
takeaways.text: Interactive (online betting and casino) lost $18.3 million, versus $76.6 million a year earlier. Management says it is on track for its full-year Interactive profit target, helped by Hollywood iCasino and Canada.

takeaways.label: Casinos still growing
takeaways.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion for a third quarter, and its profit margin rose to 33.7%, the third straight quarter of year-over-year gains. Management said October trends stayed healthy.

takeaways.label: Profit jump
takeaways.text: Company-wide adjusted EBITDA rose to $284.0 million from $194.9 million. Net income was $32.6 million, against a year-ago loss of $865.1 million caused by a large write-down.

takeaways.label: Debt keeps falling
takeaways.text: Net debt (excluding lease obligations) fell to $1.76 billion from $2.22 billion at year-end, with $1.0 billion of cash. Net debt is now 2.3 times annual EBITDA, down from 4.5 times.

history.verdict: Record casino results and a smaller digital loss won modest approval.

reasons.label: Record casino quarter
reasons.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion; nine properties set Q2 records, and July trends stayed strong.

reasons.label: Digital losses shrinking
reasons.text: Interactive lost $9.5 million versus $62.0 million a year ago; iCasino revenue hit a record.

reasons.label: Profit jump, debt falling
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose to $312.6 million from $236.1 million; net debt fell to $1.9 billion.
